title: Calc-chain assembly of the invariant terminal value for IMO 2026 Q1
intent: Reduce the correctness of the explicit invariant — that the unique large entry M of a terminal board reachable from an initial board equals Mval B₀ — to seven already-proved lemmas joined by two calc chains: one showing the prime factors of B₀.prod are exactly those of M, the other rewriting the invariant product into M's prime factorization.

parent.name: terminal_value_eq_Mval
parent.statement:
theorem terminal_value_eq_Mval (B₀ : Board) (hB₀ : IsInitial B₀)
    (B' : Board) (hreach : Reachable B₀ B') (hterm : IsTerminal B')
    (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 < M) (hMem : M ∈ B') :
    M = Mval B₀

children.name: initial_allPositive
children.statement: lemma initial_allPositive {B : Board} (hB : IsInitial B) : AllPositive B
children.closed_by: intro a ha; exact (hB.2 a ha).trans' Nat.zero_lt_one (no named lemma)

children.name: reachable_allPositive
children.statement: lemma reachable_allPositive {B B' : Board} (hB : AllPositive B) (hreach : Reachable B B') : AllPositive B'
children.closed_by: induction hreach; tail case closed by move_allPositive ih hmove (line 149)

children.name: statement_a_unique_large
children.statement: theorem statement_a_unique_large (B₀ : Board) (hB₀ : IsInitial B₀) (B' : Board) (hreach : Reachable B₀ B') (hterm : IsTerminal B') : HasUniqueLarge B'
children.closed_by: obtain ⟨a, ha, ha1⟩ := reachable_hasLarge hB₀ hreach; then Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one with Nat.le_antisymm hterm hpos

children.name: terminal_prod_eq_large
children.statement: lemma terminal_prod_eq_large {B : Board} (hpos : AllPositive B) (huniq : HasUniqueLarge B) {M : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) (hMem : M ∈ B) : B.prod = M
children.closed_by: terminal_erase_all_one hpos huniq hM hMem; then Multiset.prod_eq_one, Multiset.cons_erase; simp [htail]

children.name: reachable_prod_primeFactors
children.statement: lemma reachable_prod_primeFactors {B B' : Board} (hB : AllPositive B) (hreach : Reachable B B') : B'.prod.primeFactors = B.prod.primeFactors
children.closed_by: induction hreach; tail case closed by move_allPositive ih.1 hmove and move_prod_primeFactors ih.1 hmove (lines 149, 323)

children.name: reachable_gExp
children.statement: lemma reachable_gExp {B B' : Board} (hreach : Reachable B B') (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : gExp p B' = gExp p B
children.closed_by: induction hreach; tail case closed by (move_gExp hmove p hp).trans ih (line 250)

children.name: terminal_gExp_eq_padicValNat
children.statement: lemma terminal_gExp_eq_padicValNat {B : Board} (hpos : AllPositive B) (huniq : HasUniqueLarge B) {M p : ℕ} (hM : 1 < M) (hMem : M ∈ B) : gExp p B = padicValNat p M
children.closed_by: terminal_erase_all_one hpos huniq hM hMem; then Multiset.gcd_eq_zero_iff, padicValNat_one_right p, Multiset.cons_erase; simp [htail]

applicability.goal_shape: An equality M = f B where the right side is a product over a finite set of primes (here ∏ p ∈ B.prod.primeFactors, p ^ gExp p B) and the left side M is already characterised by two lemmas: one equating the board's product (or its prime factors) to M, one equating each gExp/valuation to M's prime factorization.
applicability.use_when: the invariant is expressed as a product over prime factors and each link of the chain is an already-proved named lemma, so transitivity is checked by the chain itself; the per-prime step under a Finset.prod_congr can itself be a nested calc.
applicability.avoid_when: a link cannot be stated as its own lemma and must be proved inline with a nontrivial argument (then that step is the real content and should be a child lemma); the equality is between terms of different types; or a single rw/simp closes the goal more directly than a chain.

claims.claim: The authors state the intent in the doc comment above the theorem: 'For any terminal board B' reachable from an initial board B₀, the unique entry M > 1 of B' equals the invariant Mval B₀.'

The same calc-over-gExp move is reused in statement_b_invariance (lines 399-404), chaining padicValNat p M = gExp p B₁ = gExp p B₀ = gExp p B₂ = padicValNat p N from the same two lemmas reachable_gExp and terminal_gExp_eq_padicValNat.

metrics.how_counted: parent_lines = site lines 419-451; children = the 7 named lemmas; 'induction' counts reachable_allPositive, reachable_prod_primeFactors, reachable_gExp which close by induction on Reachable; the other 4 (initial_allPositive, statement_a_unique_large, terminal_prod_eq_large, terminal_gExp_eq_padicValNat) close by unfolding/simp/one sibling lemma

consequences: The move creates no new goals of its own: every calc link is a transitive step justified by a named lemma or by a congr 1 / Finset.prod_congr under a product, so the obligations are pushed onto the lemmas (prime factors invariant along a reach; a terminal board collapses to its one large entry). The final link `M.factorization.prod (fun p e => p ^ e) = M` needs Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self (by omega), and that omega obligation consumes hM : 1 < M; without M > 1 the chain's last link does not close. A failure mode: if a per-prime link is not already a lemma, the inner calc under prod_congr must carry the whole argument and the 'each link is a named lemma' property breaks.
